payload.description:
Purpose: The operator path for scanner recall is the Plexus CLI against local GraphQL, not MCP and not a dumped JSON ingest.

Child story DATAP-af2f48 holds the Gherkin. Massage before coding.
payload.title: Run scanner recall with plexus evaluate accuracy
